name: Ferienwohnung Pendling
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Pendling is located in the tranquil municipality of Thiersee in the Tiroler Unterland. The surroundings are characterized by a quiet, natural landscape with forests and meadows. Guests can expect tastefully furnished accommodation that offers comfort and coziness. The atmosphere is relaxing and invites you to unwind from everyday life. Numerous hiking trails start right at the doorstep and lead through the picturesque mountain scenery. In winter, the nearby ski areas attract visitors with perfectly groomed slopes. The Thiersee itself is also a popular destination for water sports enthusiasts and those seeking relaxation.
